doc.title: Any Monday

listing.title: Undated Digital Planner for Goodnotes, Portrait iPad Planner, Start Any Month, Hyperlinked Daily Weekly Monthly Planner, Notability
listing.description:
Any Monday is an undated digital planner for Goodnotes on iPad. Start on any day of the year, write your own dates, and keep going for 52 weeks. Nothing runs out on December 31.

What's inside (453 pages in one PDF)
- Cover, Contents and a Year overview with blank month grids
- Start here page: 4 steps to get going in five minutes
- Setup check page: buttons that jump, a pen test and a fix list
- Weeks page: all 52 weeks in one place, with a line to write each week's first date
- 12 month pages, each with a 6-row grid so every month fits, Goals this month and Notes
- 12 monthly habit trackers (14 habits, 31 days)
- 52 week pages: two tall columns of day boxes, This week's top 3 and Next week
- 364 day pages: Top 3, To do, Notes, Time blocks from 6am to 9pm, Good things today
- Lists page (To buy, To try, To read or watch)
- 6 notes pages

What makes it different
- Undated, and the weeks follow you: Week 1 is the week you start, whatever the month. Week 2 follows, then Week 3, for 52 weeks.
- Portrait pages in the iPad's own 3:4 shape, so the page fills the screen in Goodnotes with no blank bands at the sides.
- Hyperlinked: month tabs down the right edge of every page; Home, Year, Lists, Notes and Weeks on the top bar; every day box on a week page has an Open button for its day; every day has large previous and next buttons, including from Sunday to the next Monday.
- One file, no zip, no stickers or add-ons to import.
- Two typefaces only, quiet ink and indigo with soft gold, large clear text.

Please note
- Undated: you write the dates. Weeks start on Monday.
- Portrait only. English only.
- Handwrite with a stylus or use your app's text tool. It is not a fillable form.
- No stickers, budget, meal or fitness sections.

Works with
Goodnotes (made for it first), Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes and Xodo on iPad and Android tablets. You need a PDF planner app. Not made for phones, e-ink tablets, or viewing in Files, Photos or a Google Drive preview.

How to start
1. Download from Etsy in a web browser (the Etsy app cannot download digital files).
2. Open the PDF in Goodnotes: Share, then Open in Goodnotes. Or in Goodnotes tap New, then Import, and choose the file.
3. Tap Open planner, follow Start here, open Week 1 and write this Monday's date.

Quick answers
- I can't download it in the Etsy app. Etsy's app does not download digital files. Open Etsy in a web browser, go to Purchases and download from there.
- Which app do I need? Goodnotes, Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes or Xodo. Files, Photos and Google Drive previews show the pages but cannot follow links.
- The links don't do anything. Turn the pen off (read or view mode) and tap again. The Setup check page tests this in one minute.
- Can I type? Yes, with your app's text tool. The pages are not a fillable form.
- How do undated weeks work? Week 1 is whichever week you start in. Write its Monday's date on the week page and on the Weeks page, then carry on with Week 2.

What you get
Any-Monday.pdf (13.1 MB, 453 pages).
Digital download. Nothing is shipped.

Help
Start with the Setup check page in the planner. Still stuck? Send the shop an Etsy message.

evidence.positioning: For Goodnotes users on an iPad who want one calm everyday planner they can start the week they buy it, in any month, and never have to replace when the year rolls over: an undated portrait planner whose pages fill the iPad screen, opens in the first five minutes (Start here plus a Setup check page), and keeps every page two taps away. It wins against the 600-page dated bundles on the things their buyers complain about most: downloads and setup, apps and screen fit, and getting lost.

checks.closest: Digital Planner for GoodNotes, 2026 Undated, iPad Notability Planner (Digital Download)

visual.issue: Start here step 1 and photo 9 say 'In Goodnotes, use Share, then Open in Goodnotes': Share then Open in Goodnotes happens in Safari or Files after the download, not inside Goodnotes, so a buyer may look for a Share button in Goodnotes (the listing's step 2 is worded correctly).
The Habit tracker and All weeks buttons on every month page have tap boxes only 23 pt tall in the PDF (about 31 px, 68x23 and 53x23 pt), well under a 44 px finger target, so they are easy to miss.
Top-bar pills, trails and week Open buttons are 30 pt tall (40 px), just under 44 px; day prev/next arrows are 36x31 pt (48x42 px), which is not the 'large' buttons the listing promises.
visual.where: all pages top bar, u010-u526 nav

visual.issue: The Contents 'Habit trackers' card always opens January's tracker, even for a buyer starting in another month.
In the Setup check top-bar map, Lists reads 'Three lists: to buy, to try, to read', but the page's third list is 'To read or watch'.
Photo 1 is captioned 'Cover and a day page', but the day page is almost fully hidden behind the cover; only its top bar and 'Week 1 · date' show.
In photos 3 and 7, the landscape crop fills only the middle of the frame, leaving large empty bands above and below.
Photo 4's crop ends on a thin sliver of the cut-off Notes box under Goals this month.
The cover uses a cool blue-grey #ECEEF6 rather than the warm ivory of the brief's look (inner pages are ivory).
The date blanks are small for handwriting: '_ _' in each week day box and 'date ____' in the day page eyebrow.
Week 52 still prints a 'Next week' box although the planner ends there.

standard.name: Dated for the year
standard.how: Deliberately undated: undated listings hold 63% of all-time sales among top sellers and our dated Goodnotes planner (Just Today, p-adhd-001) already covers the dated 2027 buyer. The listing says undated in the title.

standard.name: Covers more than one year
standard.how: Works for any year and any start day: 12 undated month pages, 52 week pages numbered from the week the buyer starts (not tied to fixed months) and 364 day pages. The buyer writes the dates; nothing expires on December 31.

unique.name: Start any day, weeks that follow you

unique.why: Buyers ask for next year's edition and complain about months with missing date boxes; an undated planner that fits every month removes both, and lets an October or mid-year buyer start today.
